consequence.statement: A configuration using the Docker provider with swarmMode is unsupported in v3 and prevents Traefik from starting.
consequence.remediation: Do not use swarmMode with the Docker provider; use the Swarm provider instead.

assertion.statement: In v3 the Docker provider's swarmMode option is unsupported (Swarm moved to a separate Swarm provider), and configuring providers.docker.swarmMode prevents Traefik from starting.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for config-key removed
